page.overview:
Who is Moss the Chronicler?

Moss the Chronicler is an unseen historical character in Final Fantasy XVI. He was a scholar on Valisthean history and legend whose controversial annals, the Journal of Moss, contains information about the Circle of Malius cult and their god, Ultima, that has otherwise largely been struck from official historical records. Getting his hands on a rare copy of the journal with the Undying's help inspired Joshua Rosfield to pursue knowledge on these subjects to uncover the truth of the Night of Flames. Whether this is intended to be his copy of the Journal of Moss, his personal journal, or a book of different origin, is ambiguous.}}

While the young Harpocrates II Hyperboreos still lived on the outer continent, he met Moss when the scholar visited his village and briefly took the boy under his wing. Though Moss soon moved on to continue his travels, the encounter inspired the young Harpocrates to continue seeking knowledge and become a scholar himself.

Moss was likely native to Valisthea and was only visiting the outer continent for scholarly pursuits, as he became a famous scholar in Valisthea at some point in time, and much of the contemporary knowledge of the antiquity of the Twins stems from Moss's research. During the end of his career he delved into study of the ancient Circle of Malius cult and the god they worshipped. These findings were denounced as "baseless speculation" in many scholarly circles, spurred especially by rival scholars, and failed to become widespread, leading to Moss withdrawing from public life.
